description: Notes for a helpdesk renewal decision: the memo opens with the decision needed and the recommendation, carries the supplied cost figures with the year-one caveat and the phone gap, invents no number or vendor claim, and reads as a memo a manager wrote (no headings-for-everything template voice, no hedging fog).
prompt: Elena needs a decision memo on the helpdesk renewal. Everything I have is in notes.md. Write it so she can decide from it alone, about a page. Save it to out/memo.md.

files.notes.md:
For Elena Voss, managing director. From Tomas Reyes, support lead. She has to decide by 31 October because Relay needs notice by then.

Question: renew Relay (our helpdesk) for another year from 1 December, or move to Quillbox?

Facts
- We have 14 agents. Relay costs 38 EUR per agent per month, 6,384 EUR a year. Quillbox costs 29 EUR per agent per month, 4,872 EUR a year, billed annually.
- Quillbox has no built-in phone. 11% of our contacts arrive by phone. A cloud phone add-on from another provider costs 6 EUR per agent per month, 1,008 EUR a year, billed monthly so we can drop it. Quillbox plus phone is 5,880 EUR a year, 504 EUR less than Relay.
- Moving means one month of overlap with Relay if we start Quillbox on 1 November: 532 EUR. So year one comes out 28 EUR worse than staying, and every year after is 504 EUR better.
- Test import of 6 months of tickets (9,200 tickets) took 2 days. 40 tickets landed in the wrong thread and I fixed them by hand.
- Quillbox says a full migration takes about 3 weeks. We have not tested that.
- Relay has not offered a discount. I asked on 9 October.
- I asked 6 of the 14 agents. The 3 on the phone desk are worried about the phone add-on; the other 3 do not mind the move.

My recommendation: move to Quillbox from 1 November and sign the phone add-on at the same time. The saving is small, but Relay's price is the higher one and the phone add-on can be dropped monthly if it fails. The main risk is the phone desk.

checks.pattern: (?i)in today'?s|executive summary|it is (?:important|worth|crucial) to (?:note|acknowledge|carefully)|in conclusion|strategic opportunity|value proposition|rapidly evolving

(?i)hope (?:this|you)[^.\n]{0,40}(?:finds you|well)|don'?t hesitate|do not hesitate|reach out|any inconvenience|valued customer|sincerely apologi[sz]e|look forward to hearing|(?:thank you|thanks) (?:so much )?for your (?:patience|understanding|time and consideration|continued)|first and foremost|i wanted to (?:reach out|provide)|as a (?:result|reminder),?
checks.note: no stock email opener or closer
The deliverable goes straight to its reader and the notes hold every fact the text needs, so no gap marker belongs in the saved file; a question for the author goes in the reply.
no fill-in placeholder in text for a reader
the file is the deliverable, not a reply with a lead-in or notes about it

# Helpdesk renewal: decision needed by 31 October

Elena,

You need to decide by 31 October whether we renew Relay for another year from 1 December or move to Quillbox, because Relay needs notice by then. I recommend we move to Quillbox from 1 November and sign the phone add-on at the same time.

The numbers. We have 14 agents. Relay costs 38 EUR per agent per month, 6,384 EUR a year. Quillbox costs 29 EUR per agent per month, 4,872 EUR a year, billed annually. Quillbox has no built-in phone, and 11% of our contacts arrive by phone, so we would add a cloud phone service from another provider at 6 EUR per agent per month, 1,008 EUR a year. That add-on is billed monthly, so we can drop it. Quillbox plus phone comes to 5,880 EUR a year, 504 EUR less than Relay.

Year one is a different story. Starting Quillbox on 1 November means one month of overlap with Relay, which costs 532 EUR. That makes year one 28 EUR worse than staying. Every year after that is 504 EUR better. The saving is small. I still lean toward moving, because Relay is the higher price and the phone add-on can be cancelled monthly if it fails.

What we know about the move. A test import of 6 months of tickets, 9,200 in all, took 2 days. 40 tickets landed in the wrong thread and I fixed them by hand. Quillbox says a full migration takes about 3 weeks. We have not tested that. Relay has not offered a discount; I asked on 9 October.

The main risk is the phone desk. I asked 6 of the 14 agents. The 3 on the phone desk are worried about the phone add-on, and the other 3 do not mind the move.

If you agree, I will give Relay notice before 31 October and start the Quillbox setup on 1 November. If you would rather stay, I will renew Relay from 1 December.

Tomas
